$comment: The ONE source of the steady-state scheduler rows (zheref/hatsu#448; the SDD plan's steady-state row). The host scheduler is the maintainer's ruling R-2026-10-23-21 (effort HA-IS-#450, OQ-1 of zheref/hatsu#448): Claude Code Desktop's LOCAL scheduled tasks on the maintainer's own machine, which fire only while the Desktop app is open and the machine is awake. scripts/schedule_install.mts PRINTS each desktop-task row as the fields of Desktop's New scheduled task form and the SKILL.md Desktop keeps at ~/.claude/scheduled-tasks/<name>/SKILL.md; it registers nothing and writes nothing, because the machine is the maintainer's. A ci row is not a task: it names the workflow job that already carries it. Page: docs/config/schedule.md. Where a copy of a value below disagrees with this file, this file wins and the copy is the bug.

placeholders.<hatsu>: --folder: the absolute path of the maintainer's Hatsu checkout (default: the checkout this script runs from)
placeholders.<spec>: --spec-folder: the absolute path of the family's private spec-repository checkout (docs/config/spec-repo.md)
placeholders.<family>: --family: the family slug; a private value, printed to stdout only and never written to a tree
placeholders.<repo>: --repo: the owner/name the morning desk renders (default zheref/hatsu)

rows.name: hatsu-drift-pass
rows.description: Quarterly canon drift pass: great-hiker evolve on every surface, dry first, one issue per drifted surface, nothing filed twice on the same day.

trigger.reads: 09:07 local on the first day of January, April, July and October

rows.permissionMode: Ask permissions (the default); never a bypass mode
prompt: Quarterly canon drift pass: row drift-pass of docs/config/schedule.md, ruling R-2026-10-23-21. Work read-only in this checkout: edit no file, commit nothing, push nothing, open no pull request; a pure data edit great-hiker section 7 step 5 would open is listed for the maintainer's typed hatsu:great-hiker call instead.

1. Dry. Run hatsu:great-hiker evolve over every surface and print the drift table (per surface, each changed row with the fetched line beside the guide's line, and every page that could not be fetched as unread with its status). File nothing in this step.

2. Reconcile. For each drifted surface run nen issue search --target zheref/hatsu --subject "Surface drift: <surface>". An open issue for that surface is amended (great-hiker section 7 step 4), never duplicated; an issue for that surface opened or closed today means the surface is skipped and said; a search that could not run is reported as not run, never as nothing found, and that surface is not filed.
3. File. File one issue per remaining drifted surface through hatsu:file, which shows its one plan and waits in this session for the maintainer's confirmation.
End with the drift table, every issue filed or amended as a link, and every surface skipped with its reason. Never a release step (HR-5).

rows.name: hatsu-family-recapture
rows.description: Weekly dry recapture of one product family's living spec, reading every member's tip; the real recapture stays the maintainer's typed call.
rows.permissionMode: Ask permissions (the default); never a bypass mode
prompt: Weekly family recapture, dry: row recapture of docs/config/schedule.md, ruling R-2026-10-23-21. Write nothing outside the scratch directory, write no run record, open no pull request.
If this family has no first capture yet (zheref/hatsu#446), say so in one line and stop.
Otherwise run hatsu:dowsing-chain recapture <family> --dry-run in this spec checkout and report, per member, the tip it read and what a real recapture would change.

End with one line: changed members, or a byte-identical recapture said as such. The real recapture is the maintainer's typed hatsu:dowsing-chain recapture <family>, ending at its spec pull request's merge prompt at G2. Never a release step (HR-5).

rows.name: hatsu-morning-desk
rows.description: Weekday morning register: the Rikugan register page over one repository, every verdict quoted, the last idle run first.
rows.permissionMode: Ask permissions (the default); never a bypass mode
prompt: Morning desk: row morning-desk of docs/config/schedule.md, ruling R-2026-10-23-21. Strictly read-only: no label, no comment, no push, no merge.
Run hatsu:rikugan for <repo> as register, each pull request's readiness quoted from nen pr ready, never judged by eye.
If a hatsu:futon --idle run on <repo> ended since the previous desk, put its terminal state and its parked efforts above the fold and link that run's last report.
End with the page's link. Never a release step (HR-5).

rows.reads: every pull request (opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review): scripts/prose_ambiguity_check.mts held against the trusted base revision's contracts/prose.lint.baseline.json prints `<n> removed over <base>` in its canon-lint summary line and `removedBaseline` in --json
